insightCreate.name: #1512 {{case_name}} APM SQL timeline p{{page_number}}/{{page_count}}
insightCreate.description: Trace {{trace_id_hex}}; UTC [{{window_start_iso}}, {{window_end_iso}}); rows {{row_start}}-{{row_end}}/{{row_count}}. Offset from {{anchor_utc}}; ms (3 dp). Official APM SQL table, not Tracing drawer. Status 0=unset, 1=OK, 2=error.

source.query:
WITH selected_spans AS (
    SELECT timestamp, uuid, span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, duration_nano, status_code
    FROM posthog.trace_spans
    WHERE timestamp >= toDateTime('{{window_start_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND timestamp < toDateTime('{{window_end_utc}}', 'UTC')
      AND timestamp >= {filters.dateRange.from}
      AND timestamp < {filters.dateRange.to}
      AND service_name IN ('mikka-web', 'mikka-daemon')
      AND coalesce(nullIf(resource_attributes['deployment.environment.name'], ''), resource_attributes['deployment.environment']) = 'production'
      AND trace_id = base64Encode(unhex('{{trace_id_hex}}'))
), timed_spans AS (
    SELECT timestamp, uuid, span_id, parent_span_id, service_name, name, duration_nano, status_code,
        dateDiff('microsecond', min(timestamp) OVER (), timestamp) / 1000 AS offset_ms
    FROM selected_spans
)
SELECT service_name AS service, name AS stage, offset_ms,
    duration_nano / 1000000 AS duration_ms, status_code,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(span_id))) AS span_id_hex,
    lower(hex(base64Decode(parent_span_id))) AS parent_span_id_hex
FROM timed_spans
WHERE toString(uuid) IN ({{row_uuids_sql}})
ORDER BY timestamp, span_id, uuid
LIMIT {{page_limit}}

sourceBindingRules: Only bind from the actual case's reconciled fixed-window manifest, never schema fixtures, old baseline traces or invented IDs.
All raw APM data and independent counts are collected through unchanged frozen fourteen queries first. This projection is for display only.
Build consecutive UUID pages from the canonical span_timeline page rows in their existing timestamp/base64-span-id/UUID order.
UUID membership is applied AFTER the full-scope window function; no per-page reset of offset_ms.
Use actual page row count plus one as page_limit, at most nine, to detect unexpected extra matches. Expected visible row count remains at most eight.
Return only seven selected safe columns; tableSettings.columns is not relied on to hide raw fields.
No guessed cluster/connectionId, no events/AI table join, no OFFSET, no partial query placeholders in a real call.
Eight rows is a conservative preparation choice, not a proven visible capacity. PNG pixels remain the deciding rendering check.
